rationale: Optimal schedule maximizing critical-load energy served. Both EVs discharge proportionally to their available energy (7.2 kWh each to load). EV A serves 5+6+3.4=14.4 kW over 0.5h intervals (7.2 kWh to load), ending at reserve SOC of 16 kWh. EV B serves 5+6+3.4=14.4 kW over 0.5h intervals (7.2 kWh to load), ending at reserve SOC of 12 kWh. Total served energy is 14.4 kWh, which is the maximum possible given the 14.4 kWh total available from both EVs accounting for discharge efficiency.
